name: Mallcom (India) Ltd
title: Mallcom (India) Ltd - 539400 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 EBITDA margin fell 185bp YoY to 9.34% on raw-material costs and export price concessions; management targets 10-12% growth and a return to pre-investment margins, but gives no numbers for margin recovery.

utilisation.quote: as of now, we are running at around 50% capacity, and we are trying to improve it gradually

capex.quote: going forward, definitely, with the lesser capex and more of cash generation

triggers.label: Sanand utilisation ~50%
triggers.quote: as of now, we are running at around 50% capacity, and we are trying to improve it gradually

triggers.label: Capex falls to INR10-15 cr/yr
triggers.quote: going forward, we hope that the year-wise capex should be in the range of INR10 crores to INR15 crores as of now

triggers.label: Domestic price list revised twice
triggers.quote: in the last quarter, we've revised our price list twice to be able to pass on the prices

triggers.label: Export concessions to hold share
triggers.quote: in a lot of cases, even to maintain market share, we have to offer some concessions even in the U.S. market

triggers.label: Unorganised players may not survive
triggers.quote: a lot of these unorganized players will not be able to survive in such a scenario, and we are seeing that happening as well

guidance.quote: 10%, 12% is the bare minimum we should be hitting, and we are confident of doing that for this year
year-wise capex should be in the range of INR10 crores to INR15 crores as of now
INR40 crores minimum, INR40 crores on annual basis

guidance.value: most debt repaid in next 4 years
guidance.quote: we can pay most of the debt in next 4 years

red_flags.label: Export pricing concessions to hold share
red_flags.quote: in a lot of cases, even to maintain market share, we have to offer some concessions even in the U.S. market

red_flags.label: Export receivables / LatAm credit risk
red_flags.quote: We don't offer any sort of credit to them.

evasions.quote: But yes, it's very difficult to say at this point of how this will pan out this year.
there are a lot of ifs and buts in it at this moment
